What is Khanmigo?

AI tutor and teaching assistant from the non-profit Khan Academy, built on GPT models and tuned to Socratic tutoring - it guides students to the answer rather than giving it, and gives teachers lesson planning and progress insight.

Best for

Socratic K-12 tutoring with adult oversight built in.

Main features

  • Socratic tutoring that withholds direct answers
  • writing coach
  • debate practice partner
  • teacher tools for lesson planning, rubric and quiz generation
  • progress reports and student activity transcripts for teachers and parents
  • integration with Khan Academy's full curriculum
  • safety guardrails and moderation logging.

Practical use cases

  • One-to-one maths and reading tutoring
  • essay coaching
  • generating differentiated lesson plans
  • creating quizzes aligned to standards
  • giving parents visibility into a child's learning.

Who is it for?

  • K-12 students, teachers, school districts, parents and homeschoolers.

Pricing, free access & limits

Free for US teachers (district/philanthropy funded); low-cost subscription for parents; district licensing

Plans described in the source

Free for US educators (funded by districts and philanthropy). Parents/learners around $4/mo or $44/yr. District and school licensing quoted per student, typically $35-45 per student per year. Availability and pricing vary substantially by country.

Free plan

Free for verified US teachers. Khan Academy's core content remains free worldwide; Khanmigo itself is paid for parents.

Free trial

Free trial periods offered for parent accounts; district pilots via sales.

Usage limits to consider

Usage limits are light for individuals. Availability is US-centric; many features and the free educator tier are not offered in all countries.

Strengths & tradeoffs

These points summarize the supplied research, rather than hands-on test results.

Strengths noted in the source

  • Non-profit mission and pricing - by far the cheapest credible AI tutor
  • the Socratic design genuinely resists doing the homework for the student
  • teacher and parent oversight is built into the product rather than bolted on
  • strong safety posture for minors.

Limitations to consider

  • Tied to Khan Academy's curriculum and pedagogy
  • weaker outside maths and core subjects
  • limited non-English support
  • availability restricted outside the US
  • tutoring quality still varies on advanced topics.

Platforms, languages & integrations

Platforms

  • Web, iOS, Android
  • integrates with Khan Academy platform

Languages

  • English primary; Spanish and a growing set of languages; not strong in Arabic

API access

No public API

Integrations and exports

  • Khan Academy curriculum, Google Classroom, Clever, ClassLink, Canvas (district tiers)

Evaluation notes

The oversight transcripts are the feature that matters most for school deployment - every student conversation is reviewable by a teacher or parent. Confirm availability in your country before planning around it.
